attackers_goals: Leverage access to the cloud to delete resources and cause damage to an organization's infrastructure.
description: An identity deleted multiple ML artifacts.
investigative_actions: Confirm the legitimacy of the suspected identity and what cloud resources have been deleted by the identity. Look for any unusual activity associated with the suspected identity and determine whether they are compromised.
name: ML artifacts destruction
